projects.name: Plants with Krystal
projects.about: A plant educator and speaker whose debut book, More Than Just a Plant, is about how caring for plants can help us through grief and change. The site features the book and her tour dates, plus speaking, workshops, plant consultations and a store.

projects.name: Triptych Kyoto
projects.about: A design studio that works with Kyoto artisans in wood, lacquer, handmade paper, ceramics and glass to make contemporary lighting. The site is mostly large photos of each light, with a short note on how it’s made.

projects.name: Tufas Boulder Lounge
projects.about: A community-first bouldering gym in Philadelphia. The site covers day passes and memberships, events, programs, birthday parties and gift cards, with illustrations throughout.

projects.name: The Path Home
projects.about: A therapist in Mount Kisco, New York, who works with individuals and couples on trauma, addiction, eating disorders and relationship issues, in person and by telehealth. The site covers her practice areas, her approach and background, and common questions about fees and insurance, with a way to request a free consultation.

projects.name: Redwoods & Greenfields
projects.about: A guide who leads forest bathing walks, based on the Japanese practice of shinrin-yoku. The site explains what forest bathing is and covers group, private and corporate walks, with an easy way to sign up for the next one.

projects.name: Chan ADR
projects.about: A mediation practice in the Seattle area led by Priscilla Chan, a Cantonese-speaking mediator and former Assistant U.S. Attorney. The site covers her background, how the mediation process works, testimonials and a blog, with a way to schedule a mediation.

projects.name: cfobeauty
projects.about: A hairstylist and makeup artist in Downers Grove, Illinois, who does color, cuts, extensions, bridal and theatrical makeup. The site covers services and pricing, a portfolio for each type of work, new client forms, online booking and a small shop.

projects.name: Ruta del Jefe
projects.about: A four-day bike festival in Patagonia, Arizona, that raises money for organizations working in the borderlands. The site handles registration, scholarships, partners and trip prep.

projects.name: Stef Reid
projects.about: A Paralympian and keynote speaker in London who talks to companies about resilience and performing under pressure. The site covers her speaking, past clients, press and her Hail Mary Friday Club, with a way to book her for an event.

projects.name: Iza Erkin
projects.about: A San Francisco Bay Area wedding photographer who focuses on intimate weddings, elopements and San Francisco City Hall weddings. The site shows her wedding, City Hall, and couples and family work, with a blog and a way to book a consultation.

projects.name: Cardinal Direction
projects.about: A qualitative research firm led by Kyle Bower that uses creative methods like visual storytelling and journaling. The site covers services, consulting and training, past projects, resources and a blog, with a way to book a free consultation.

projects.name: Oakland Chinatown Chamber
projects.about: The chamber of commerce for Oakland Chinatown, serving the Asian business community since 1985. The site covers membership, events like the Lunar New Year Bazaar, resources and donations, in English, Chinese and Vietnamese.

projects.name: Favarh
projects.about: A nonprofit in Connecticut’s Farmington Valley that helps people with intellectual and developmental disabilities live as independently as possible. The site covers its programs, inclusive hiring, careers, ways to get involved and its thrift shop.

projects.name: The Whisper Group
projects.about: An advisory firm that helps women business owners get their companies ready to sell. The site covers its exit readiness program, buying and selling a business, and a community for women who have sold, with a quiz that gives each owner a readiness score.

projects.name: VIBE Pilates
projects.about: A Pilates studio with 40-minute, rhythm-based classes on Xformer machines in an infrared-heated room. The site covers the VIBE Method, pricing and packages, the instructors and job openings, with online booking.

projects.name: Luretik
projects.about: A small certified organic olive oil producer in California’s Santa Ynez Valley, with 900 trees in nine Italian varieties. The site is an online shop for its oils and gift sets, plus pages on how the oil is made, where to buy it and a blog.

projects.name: Clementine Promos
projects.about: A company that makes branded merchandise and corporate gifts, from new hire kits and apparel to event giveaways. The site covers its services, past work, lookbooks and trends, with a shop and a form to start a project.

projects.name: Cooc & Associates
projects.about: A law firm with offices in Oakland and San Francisco that handles general civil cases, family law and personal injury. The site covers its practice areas, attorneys, a blog and legal resources, with a client portal, a language switcher and a way to request a consultation.

projects.name: Honest Family Dental
projects.about: A family dental practice in Austin, Texas. The site covers why patients choose the practice, its membership plans and prices, patient reviews, and the office’s hours and location, with a button to book an appointment.
